Rajnath Singh Warns Pakistan Over Kashmir

On Kargil Vijay Diwas, Defence Minister Rajnath Singh addressed a video message to Pakistan, warning it over the situation in Kashmir. The message was released on social media from Dras in Ladakh. Singh said that India will not tolerate any attempt to undermine its sovereignty and territorial integrity. He also appealed to Pakistan to refrain from making provocative statements. The message came ahead of the 26th anniversary of Kargil Vijay Diwas, which commemorates the Indian Army's victory over Pakistani forces in 1999.
